flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminapi workflows/payment_reduction/reduction/{ReductionController,ReductionServiceImpl,helpers/ReductionPersistenceService,helpers/ReductionValidator}, workflows/notice_creation/core/helpers/TsDueDateRule. ocmsadminprivateapi crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsValidOffenceNotice/OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository (findToppanNoticesForStage, findNoticesForMhaNricUpload), framework/workflows/agencies/toppan/upload/{helpers/ToppanUploadHelper,jobs/ToppanUploadJob}, framework/schedulers/ToppanUploadJobsScheduler, framework/workflows/autorevival/helpers/AutoRevivalHelper, framework/workflows/notification_sms_email/helpers/NotificationSmsEmailHelper, framework/workflows/agencies/mha/upload/helpers/MhaNricDataHelper, framework/workflows/datahiveuenfin/services/DataHiveUenFinService, cron-schedules-prod.properties. ocmsadminui: only the Fine Reduction label. ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: not relevant
note: The story is not in a flow deck; 'Sesuai' means the code does what the story text says. Story status: Demo paid (50% of 75%), a written requirement exists. The core mechanism is one column: a reduction sets VON.suspension_type = 'TS' (reason RED), and every query that raises the stage (Toppan letters, MHA, DataHive) filters suspension_type IS NULL, so the notice does not escalate while the reduction is valid. A reduction can only be applied through PLUS (POST /plus-apply-reduction); a reduction route from the OCMS staff portal was not found (a 'Fine Reduction' label exists, the form is commented out). Something's missing on the execution side: the Toppan letter job is not scheduled daily (the call is commented out, ToppanUploadJobsScheduler.java:118) and the SMS/email job is off in prod (cron.notification.enabled=false), so 'reminders are not sent' is correct in logic, but according to the repo the automatic reminders themselves do not run. Related tickets: OCMS-DF-2026-072, OCMS-DF-2026-028, OCMS-DF-2026-078 (all Closed). Real server property values cannot verify from repo.
recommendation: Claim most of it: the escalation block (suspension_type IS NULL) and automatic revival exist. Record two execution gaps (Toppan letters manual only, SMS/email job off in prod) and the reduction route from the OCMS staff portal that was not found.

steps.step: Composition amount reduction was applied successfully via OCMS or PLUS (story precondition)
steps.detail: The PLUS route exists: POST /plus-apply-reduction (ReductionController.java:29), then validation of status, amount and date, then persistenceService.applyReduction (ReductionServiceImpl.java:113). The 'in OCMS' route from the staff portal was not found: ocmsadminui only has a 'Fine Reduction' label (translation.json:737) and a commented-out useEffect block in the operation form (NoticeOperationForm.tsx:173-175); there is no reduction API call in ocmsadminui. Protection of the plus-* endpoints depends on APIM (JwtFilter skips plus-*), cannot verify from repo. Ticket OCMS-DF-2026-072 (Closed, Prod deployed) only changed what amount_payable holds in ocms_reduced_offence_amount.

steps.step: The reduced notice is marked TS-RED: VON gets suspension_type TS and reason RED, with a row in ocms_suspended_notice
steps.detail: updateIntranetValidOffenceNotice sets suspension_type='TS', epr_reason_of_suspension='RED' and the new amount_payable (ReductionPersistenceService.java:101-109); insertSuspendedNotice writes the TS/RED row (:127-135); eVON is mirrored (:205-208). The four updates are called in sequence inside one transaction (:63-66).

steps.step: The reduction period is set by the expiry date, which is used as the revival date
steps.detail: validateDates rejects an expiry earlier than the date of reduction (ReductionValidator.java:264-271). The expiry is stored as dueDateOfRevival in ocms_suspended_notice (ReductionPersistenceService.java:135) and as expiryDate in ocms_reduced_offence_amount (:168); on VON, TsDueDateRule.furthest is used, i.e. the furthest date when another TS already exists (:105-106; TsDueDateRule.java:22).

steps.step: The reminder/demand letter job (RD1 to DR3) does not select suspended notices, so the notice does not escalate
steps.detail: findToppanNoticesForStage only selects notices with next_processing_stage = :stage, next_processing_date <= today, and von.suspension_type IS NULL (OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.java:608-611). A notice with any suspension (TS or PS) is not in the letter list, and stage/next_processing_date are only rewritten for notices in that list (ToppanUploadHelper.java:1887, bulk UPDATE :1514-1530). Note: the letter job only runs through POST /toppan/generate-letters (ToppanUnifiedController.java:34); the call in the day-end scheduler is commented out (ToppanUploadJobsScheduler.java:118), so 'automatically every day' is not true, but the notice selection rule the story asks for is correct. There is one thing to watch out for: the bulk UPDATE does not re-check suspension, so a notice suspended after the letter list was built in the same run still advances; how often this happens cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: Preparation of next-stage data (MHA NRIC upload and DataHive UEN/FIN) also skips suspended notices
steps.detail: The MHA NRIC upload query (findNoticesForMhaNricUpload, called at MhaNricDataHelper.java:81) and the DataHive UEN/FIN query (DataHiveUenFinService.java:236-238) both require von.suspension_type IS NULL for stages RD1-DR3 (OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.java:567). So preparation of data for the next stage also stops while TS-RED or another TS is active. One other path in MhaNricDataHelper (queryValidOffenceNoticesBasic, :196-216) only excepts TS-HST and TS-UNC, not TS-RED.

steps.step: SMS/email reminders (eNotification) are not sent for a notice that is still TS-RED
steps.detail: The eNotification queries for ENA and RD1-DR3 reminders only let through suspension_type IS NULL or TS with reason HST (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1034-1035 and :1120-1121), so TS-RED and other TS except HST get no SMS/email; TS-HST still passes, which differs from the story wording about temporary suspension. The job's own execution is switched off in prod: cron.notification.enabled=false (cron-schedules-prod.properties:236, comment 'Disabled in PROD' at :234). The real server value cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: After the reduction period ends, the notice is revived automatically and the amount is reverted so reminders can run again
steps.detail: AutoRevivalHelper revives TS rows whose due_date_of_revival is before the start of tomorrow (AutoRevivalHelper.java:398). When no suspension remains, the suspension fields on VON/eVON are cleared (:445-448) so the notice enters the letter query again; for TS-RED the amount_payable is reverted to composition plus admin fee or surcharge by stage (:467-490). This job runs in the day-end scheduler (ToppanUploadJobsScheduler.java:119) and cron.toppanupload.enabled=true (cron-schedules-prod.properties:62); the real server value cannot verify from repo. Notices whose last_processing_stage is outside REVIVAL_ALLOWED_STAGES are skipped, except court stages CSD/CSR/COS that have a TS-RED (:415-421). Tickets OCMS-DF-2026-028 and OCMS-DF-2026-072 (Closed, Prod deployed) fixed the amount source on revert; OCMS-DF-2026-078 is a data patch (Closed). After revival, the next letter is only issued when the letter job is triggered manually (see the letter step).
